user.title: Merge devices
user.description: Pick two or more devices, in priority order (the first one, A, owns the controls). Devices with the same name are told apart by letter (A, B, C) in the next steps, with their integration and model.

data.name: Name of the merged device
data.take_over_ids: Take over the first device's entity ids (renames its entities)
data.review_all: Review everything (otherwise only pairings the automatic matching is unsure about are shown)

pairing.title: Pair entities
pairing.description:
Only the pairings the automatic matching is unsure about are shown (all of them if you chose to review everything); the rest uses the suggestions. For each entity, pick the entity of an earlier device it is the same as (likeliest first), or keep it on its own.

{legend}

strategies.title: Combine values
strategies.description:
How should each merged value be combined? Shown for the pairings you reviewed; the rest uses Freshest (Maximum for counters such as the odometer). The labels show every device's current value.

{legend}

entities.title: Other entities
entities.description:
Entities that only one device has. Ticked ones are added to the merged device.

{legend}

confirm.title: Check the result
